"""Chain-threshold construction: training values at extremes -> ~190 eligible clauses."""
import json, random, sys, subprocess, time
from collections import Counter

def build(seed=0, natoms=20, B=4, k=1, nsrc=16, per_source=256, S=1, W=1,
          n_probe_ctx=128, n_query_ctx=1024):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    schema = [{'name': 'f0', 'type': 'COUNT', 'min': 0, 'max': 100}]
    thr = [1 + i * (98 // max(1, natoms - 1)) for i in range(natoms)]  # 1..99
    atoms = [{'cmp': 'ge', 'left': {'field': 'f0', 'at': 0},
              'right': {'const': t, 'type': 'COUNT'}} for t in thr]
    def rows(n, pool):
        return [{'t': i, 'values': [rnd.choice(pool)]} for i in range(n)]
    train = [{'id': 'T%d' % s, 'source': 's%d' % s,
              'rows': rows(per_source, [0, 100])} for s in range(nsrc)]
    probes = [{'id': 'P0', 'source': 's0',
               'rows': rows(n_probe_ctx, list(range(0, 101)))}]
    queries = [{'id': 'Q0', 'source': 's0',
                'rows': rows(n_query_ctx, list(range(0, 101)))}]
    return {'version': 1, 'schema': schema, 'window': k, 'atoms': atoms,
            'policy': {'max_width': B, 'min_support': S, 'min_witness': W},
            'train': train, 'probes': probes, 'queries': queries}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    kw = {}
    for a in sys.argv[1:]:
        kk, vv = a.split('=')
        try: kw[kk] = json.loads(vv)
        except Exception: kw[kk] = vv
    req = build(**kw)
    data = json.dumps(req).encode()
    print('input bytes', len(data), file=sys.stderr)
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'], input=data, capture_output=True)
    el = time.time() - t0
    print('rc=%d wall=%.2fs %s' % (p.returncode, el, p.stderr.decode()[-400:]))
    r = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    tot = sum(c['members'] for c in r['classes'])
    print('classes=%d total_members=%d queries=%d' % (len(r['classes']), tot, len(r['queries'])))
    print('statuses', Counter(q['status'] for q in r['queries']))
    print('sample sigs', [c['signature'] for c in r['classes'][:6]])
